card.name: "With" after in combination
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after "in combination" in dosing schedules, just before a second drug name. Weaker on other joining spots in combination lists.

modes.label: In combination with
modes.description: "with" after "in combination" in a cycle-based dosing line, leading into a partner drug.
modes.example: 3 weeks for 13 doses or 790 mg/9,600 units every 6 weeks for 7 doses in combination<< with>> enfortumab vedotin-e

modes.label: Other list joiners
modes.description: An article or bullet inside a list of combined or alternative agents.
